additionalDocuments.label: Wasl South Garden A–C · original brochure drawings
Wasl South Garden Building E · original floorplate pack

review.imagery: Twelve distinct project renders were visually reviewed across the official original and current brochures. D/E and A–C exteriors retain explicit phase labels. Shared interior styling is scoped to its publishing release. The repeated studio scene, generic lifestyle images, decorative texture and unrelated stock pool image are excluded. JP2 source resources are retained and converted losslessly to WebP. Card and hero use the D/E frontage. No card badges.
review.floorPlans: The 62 complete sheets distinguish original A–C and newer D/E releases. Multi-layout totals follow the printed type labels. Whole-floor overviews have varying individual unit areas. D 3 BR A prints 2,188.34 sq ft versus its 2,118.34 component sum. D 1 BR E1 prints 1,082.85 versus its 1,112.85 sq ft component sum. Other rounding, metric and source-range differences remain qualified. Obtain corrected contractual drawings from Wasl. All 23 unit-sheet type labels and visible numerical panels were visually checked. All 39 complete building floorplates were reviewed for building/level scope, with individual unit figures left on the unedited originals. The separate E pack supplies its nine floorplates, avoiding duplicate brochure choices. Hidden stale engineering text is not used for the published totals. Source notices, keys and complete pages remain intact.
review.location: Current brochure physical pages 4 and 5 were visually reviewed. All eight brochure estimates are preserved with mode unspecified and the current primary-page conflicts stated explicitly. The primary embed identifies D/E by place ID but exposes camera-centre coordinates, so project-name directions are used. No visitor entrance or walking mode is inferred.
review.provenance: Official HTML, both phase brochures and the standalone E floorplate pack are retained with ordinary-GET receipts and SHA-256 hashes. Each original gallery resource and complete drawing retains its correct phase source link. Original text research, protected identities and commercial qualifications remain intact.

unavailable: A verified phase-specific visitor-entrance coordinate, dated construction photographs and reconciled final areas were not established. The D 1 BR E1, D 3 BR A and other metric/rounding conflicts remain explicit. Travel sources disagree.
